d.seg: मुझे सिर्फ आपसे बात करूंगा व्हाट्सएप पर बस
d.tr: I will only talk to you on WhatsApp, that's it
d.j: The user explicitly suggests moving the conversation to an external communication application (WhatsApp).

d.seg: मैंने कहा क्या मैं अपना नंबर दे सकता हूं?
d.tr: I said, can I give you my number?
d.j: The user explicitly asks to share their phone number, which is a violation of the platform move policy.
